character_facts: Steelhead is resistant or immune to the vampires' mind-targeting attack because of his cybernetic construction.
Steelhead is the one credited with sealing the breach in space.
continuity_links: This page depicts the resolution of an ongoing vampire attack by showing both their failed assault on Steelhead and their collapse after the spatial breach is sealed.
dialogue_meaning: The narration explains that the vampires' usual cerebral or mental attack method fails against Steelhead's cybernetic nature.
The narration links Steelhead's action of sealing the spatial breach to the defeat of the vampires.
The final narration states that once cut off from their energy source, the vampires fall apart.
locations: A space-breach or rupture in outer space
The surrounding space near a dark triangular craft or structure
lore_facts: The vampires appear to rely on an external energy source.
A breach in space can function as the vampires' connection to that source.
The vampires use a form of attack aimed at an opponent's cerebral mass or mind.
plot_events: Narration states that vampires attack Steelhead but cannot affect him because he is largely cybernetic.
Steelhead reseals a breach in space.
After the breach is closed, the invading vampire entities lose access to their energy source.
uncertainties: The exact appearance and boundaries of Steelhead's body are partly obscured by the translucent attacking forms.
The black triangular object in the space panels is visible but not explicitly identified on this page alone.
visual_summary: The page shows a mostly mechanical figure, identified in narration as Steelhead, surrounded by translucent tube-like organisms or energy conduits that press over his armored body and weapon. In the next panels, a bright rupture or tear in space closes as streams of dark and pale tendrils converge into a glowing point. A black triangular craft or structure remains near the sealed area while the surrounding wormlike vampire forms fade or break apart in space.
